description: Source code implementing bit encoding and decoding classes (bit_encoder and bit_decoder) for handling bit-level data packing and unpacking, including methods for packing bytes, advancing bits, and unpacking data with alignment considerations.

classes.name: bit_encoder
classes.description: Class for encoding bits into a buffer, supporting packing of integers and bytes.

classes.name: bit_decoder
classes.description: Class for decoding bits from a buffer, supporting unpacking of integers and bytes, with byte alignment features.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Encodes a uint64_t value into the buffer using specified number of bits.

methods.name: pack_bytes
methods.description: Packs a span of bytes into the buffer, handling alignment.

methods.name: advance_bits
methods.description: Advances the read position by a specified number of bits.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks a value of type T from the buffer, reading the specified number of bits.

methods.name: unpack_bytes
methods.description: Unpacks a span of bytes from the buffer, handling alignment.

methods.name: unpack_aligned_bytes
methods.description: Unpacks a specified number of bytes from the buffer, ensuring byte alignment.

methods.name: align_bytes
methods.description: Aligns the buffer to the next byte boundary.
